import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class CF295C_ {

    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int[][][] memo1;
    static int[][][][] memo2;
    static int maxWeight;
    static int fiftyCount, hundredCount;
    static boolean[][][] inProgress;
    static long[][] binomialCache;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        maxWeight = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (sc.nextInt() == 50) fiftyCount++;
            else hundredCount++;
        }

        prepareCombinations();
        prepareDp1();
        int minMoves = computeMinMoves(fiftyCount, hundredCount, 0);
        if (minMoves > 100000) {
            System.out.println(-1);
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        prepareDp2(minMoves);
        System.out.println(minMoves);
        System.out.println(countPaths(fiftyCount, hundredCount, 0, minMoves));

        out.flush();
        out.close();
    }

    private static void prepareCombinations() {
        binomialCache = new long[101][101];
        for (long[] row : binomialCache) Arrays.fill(row, -1);
    }

    private static void prepareDp1() {
        memo1 = new int[2][51][51];
        inProgress = new boolean[2][51][51];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 51; k++) {
                    memo1[i][j][k] = -1;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private static void prepareDp2(int maxDepth) {
        memo2 = new int[2][51][51][maxDepth + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 51; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k <= maxDepth; k++) {
                    Arrays.fill(memo2[i][j][k], -1);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int computeMinMoves(int f, int h, int side) {
        if (f == 0 && h == 0 && side == 1) return 0;
        if (f == fiftyCount && h == hundredCount && side == 0) return 0;

        if (memo1[side][f][h] != -1) return memo1[side][f][h];
        if (inProgress[side][f][h]) return Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
        inProgress[side][f][h] = true;

        int best = Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2;
        for (int takeFifty = 0; takeFifty <= f; takeFifty++) {
            for (int takeHundred = 0; takeHundred <= h; takeHundred++) {
                if (takeFifty + takeHundred == 0) continue;
                int value = takeFifty * 50 + takeHundred * 100;
                if (value > maxWeight) continue;

                best = Math.min(best, 1 + computeMinMoves(fiftyCount - f + takeFifty, hundredCount - h + takeHundred, side ^ 1));
            }
        }

        return memo1[side][f][h] = best;
    }

    static int countPaths(int f, int h, int side, int remaining) {
        if (remaining < 0) return 0;
        if (f == 0 && h == 0 && side == 1) return remaining == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        if (f == fiftyCount && h == hundredCount && side == 0) return remaining == 0 ? 1 : 0;
        if (remaining == 0) return 0;

        if (memo2[side][f][h][remaining] != -1) return memo2[side][f][h][remaining];

        long total = 0;
        for (int takeFifty = 0; takeFifty <= f; takeFifty++) {
            for (int takeHundred = 0; takeHundred <= h; takeHundred++) {
                if (takeFifty + takeHundred == 0) continue;
                int value = takeFifty * 50 + takeHundred * 100;
                if (value > maxWeight) continue;

                long combinations = (binomial(f, takeFifty) * binomial(h, takeHundred)) % MOD;
                int subCount = countPaths(fiftyCount - f + takeFifty, hundredCount - h + takeHundred, side ^ 1, remaining - 1);
                total = (total + combinations * subCount) % MOD;
            }
        }

        return memo2[side][f][h][remaining] = (int) total;
    }

    static long binomial(int n, int k) {
        if (k > n || k < 0) return 0;
        if (k == 0 || k == n) return 1;
        if (binomialCache[n][k] != -1) return binomialCache[n][k];
        if (k > n - k) k = n - k;
        return binomialCache[n][k] = (binomial(n - 1, k - 1) + binomial(n - 1, k)) % MOD;
    }

    static class Scanner {
        private BufferedReader reader;
        private StringTokenizer tokenizer;

        public Scanner(InputStream input) {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(input));
        }

        public Scanner(String filePath) throws FileNotFoundException {
            reader = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(filePath));
        }

        public String next() throws IOException {
            while (tokenizer == null || !tokenizer.hasMoreTokens()) {
                tokenizer = new StringTokenizer(reader.readLine());
            }
            return tokenizer.nextToken();
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            return Integer.parseInt(next());
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }

        public String nextLine() throws IOException {
            return reader.readLine();
        }

        public boolean ready() throws IOException {
            return reader.ready();
        }
    }
}
